items.title: GPU-Initiated Discrete Simulated Bifurcation: Low-Latency Requests and Streaming Dense Couplings
items.summary: GPU-based optimization faces two communication bottlenecks: coordinating frequent requests and delivering dense models that exceed device memory. For resident models, a persistent service receives field updates, executes each solve within one GPU thread block, and returns the result.
